title: Amazon Q2 2026 Earnings: AWS Grows 37%, Revenue Tops $200B, Shares Jump 9% After-Hours
summary: Amazon reported Q2 2026 revenue of $200.6B (+20% YoY), beating the $196.16B estimate. AWS surged 37% YoY to $42.2B — fastest pace in 18 quarters — with operating income of $16.6B at a 39.4% margin. EPS of $5.75 vastly exceeded the $1.81 consensus. Amazon raised full-year capex guidance to ~$220B (from ~$200B) citing AI and cloud infrastructure demand. Shares jumped 9.15% in after-hours.
why: AWS大超预期（+37%）确认AI云计算需求强劲，Amazon将全年资本开支上调至2200亿美元，是英伟达/AI芯片最直接的需求侧利好；财报后IV回落，适合在波动冷却期审视sell put机会。

title: Apple Q3 2026: Record $109.4B Revenue (+16%), But Q4 Guidance of 9–11% Falls Short of 12% Consensus
summary: Apple reported fiscal Q3 2026 revenue of $109.4B (+16% YoY), beating the $108.65B estimate. iPhone revenue hit a June-quarter record of $54.3B (+22% YoY); Mac revenue up 29% to $10.4B. EPS of $1.91 edged past the $1.89 consensus. Q4 guidance of 9–11% growth missed the 12% Wall Street model, citing a 2.5pp FX headwind and worsening supply constraints. Services came in at $30.74B vs $31.22B expected. Shares fell after-hours.
why: Q4指引低于预期（9-11% vs 12%）及Services略逊，是近期谨慎信号；供应约束与汇率逆风或推高下季度隐含波动，持有AAPL期权仓位需关注IV是否抬升，sell put需等估值更明朗。

title: Fed Holds Rates at 3.50–3.75% in 9–3 Vote; 30-Year Treasury Tops 5.2%, Highest Since 2007
summary: The Federal Reserve held its benchmark rate at 3.50%–3.75% on July 29 in a 9-3 vote — three dissenters backed a 25bp hike — marking the fifth consecutive hold. Following the decision, the 30-year Treasury yield spiked to 5.244%, its highest since July 2007; the 10-year climbed to 4.677%. Chair Warsh provided no clear forward guidance. No August FOMC meeting; next key event is the Jackson Hole symposium August 27–29.
why: 长债收益率创16年新高压制全市场高估值成长股估值；港股/美股科技持仓面临更高折现率；利率长期偏高有利于sell put期权收益，但需在Jackson Hole前留意潜在政策转向风险。延续报道：美债高收益率对股市估值压制仍在持续发酵。

title: South Korea's Kospi Surges 17.9% — Largest Single-Day Gain Ever — on AI Fund Announcement and Chip Stock Rally
summary: South Korea's Kospi index surged 17.9% to 6,695.45 on July 31, its largest single-day gain on record, tracking Wall Street gains. Samsung Electronics rose 28% and SK Hynix soared 30%. Key driver: the government announced a 20 trillion won sovereign wealth fund to invest in AI, semiconductors, and data center infrastructure. The index had shed more than 17% over the prior three days on AI bubble fears and Chinese chip rivalry concerns.
why: 韩国芯片股暴涨直接带动港股存储概念板块（南方两倍做多海力士7709.HK当日涨约67%），与本组合HBM/AI算力赛道高度相关；政府主权基金入场是中长期产业支撑信号，但注意情绪过热后快速回调风险。

title: 港股7月收官：恒指月涨13.13%全球领涨，科技指数月涨7.98%，AI与存储概念周五强势
summary: 港股7月份强势收官，恒生指数7月31日收25,884.43点（当日涨0.10%），全月累计上涨13.13%，位居全球主要市场之首；恒生科技指数月涨7.98%。当日AI应用股普涨，存储概念股受韩国KOSPI大涨提振暴力反弹，南方两倍做多海力士（7709.HK）收涨约67%。
why: 港股7月全球领涨13%，持仓港股标的整体受益；但月线大涨后高位震荡风险上升，结合美债高收益率压制，建议关注短期回调风险并酌情调整covered call行权价策略。

title: SK Hynix Q2 2026: Revenue +257%, Operating Profit +557% — Record High — But Misses Estimates; HBM4 Mass Shipments Begin, 10+ LTAs Signed
summary: SK Hynix reported all-time high Q2 2026 results: revenue 79.3T won (+257% YoY), operating profit 60.5T won (+557% YoY), net profit 93.9T won. H1 cumulative revenue crossed 100T won for the first time. However, results missed analyst expectations (consensus: 84T won revenue, 64T won OP), and shares fell 9.6%. HBM4 mass shipments began in Q2; long-term supply agreements (LTAs) signed with 10+ customers including Nvidia covering ~50% of sales. Plans to significantly ramp HBM4 in H2 2026.
why: SK Hynix Q2创纪录但低预期导致股价跌近10%；HBM4量产启动并与Nvidia等锁定LTA确认AI内存需求能见度；持仓南方两倍做多海力士（7709.HK）中长期逻辑仍稳健，但杠杆ETF在单日+67%后波动损耗需关注。延续报道：Q2财报+HBM4量产+KOSPI联动仍在持续发酵。

title: 港股：南方两倍做多海力士(7709.HK)单日收涨约67%，存储概念股受KOSPI大涨提振
summary: 7月31日港股收盘，南方两倍做多海力士（7709.HK）收涨约67%，受韩国KOSPI单日大涨17.9%（SK Hynix本身涨30%、三星涨28%）强烈提振。恒生科技指数涨0.53%，AI应用股普涨，存储概念板块当日领涨港股。
why: 本组合直接相关标的单日暴涨67%（杠杆ETF放大效应显著），短期波动极高；注意杠杆ETF在高波动后的每日损耗效应，建议评估是否将高波动期权策略（sell put）应用于标的本身替代杠杆ETF持仓。

title: Circle (CRCL) Secures New York NYDFS Trust Charter; Stock Falls 7% as Bernstein Cuts Target to $140; Q2 Earnings Aug 5
summary: Circle Internet Group received a limited purpose trust charter from the NYDFS on July 31, enabling USDC reserves to be held directly by the company under New York state banking supervision. Despite this regulatory milestone, CRCL shares fell nearly 7%. Bernstein cut its price target from $190 to $140, citing competition risk from Open USD (OUSD), a rival stablecoin backed by Stripe, Coinbase, and BlackRock. Q2 2026 earnings are due August 5.
why: Circle NYDFS信托资质是USDC合规里程碑，长期利好；但OUSD竞争稳定币由Stripe/Coinbase/BlackRock背书构成实质威胁，市场担忧压制股价；Q2财报（8月5日）前隐含波动偏高，适合评估期权策略。

title: 雷军发布小米澎程N90 Max/N70 Max：旗舰增程SUV，N90 Max预售价29.99万元，综合续航1705km
summary: 7月30日小米澎程技术发布会，雷军正式发布大七座增程SUV旗舰澎程N90 Max（预售价29.99万元，满油满电综合续航1705km，可从北京直达上海无需补能）和大五座四驱增程SUV澎程N70 Max（预售价25.99万元），均搭载小米昆仑平台。雷军称N90 Max是50万元以内最好SUV之一。两款车计划2026年9月正式上市交付，当晚21:00开启预订（意向金1000元）。
why: 小米汽车推出澎程增程系列拓展至中高端家用市场，9月上市前关注预订量作为市场信心指标；持仓小米（1810.HK）车/家/AI全生态逻辑再次强化，中长期估值支撑增加。

title: 老铺黄金(6181.HK)：上半年预盈净利约43亿元（+83-85%），但股价年内跌超73%，机构纷纷下调目标价
summary: 老铺黄金（6181.HK）发布上半年盈利预告，预计H1营收约198-204亿元（同比+60-66%），调整后净利润约43.1-43.6亿元（+83-85%）。但Q2数据显示环比显著下滑，远低于市场预期，叠加金价从年内高点回落逾28%（现约4100美元/盎司），股价年内累计下跌超73%（从历史高点约1065港元），机构纷纷下调目标价。
why: 老铺黄金业绩增长神话遭遇金价回调与Q2环比下滑双重打击，一口价模式在弱金价环境下承压；若持有相关期权仓位，高波动率可能抬升premium但定向风险偏空；关注H2金价走势能否企稳以支撑下半年业绩预期。
